value.rationale: An exact all-state objective guarantee is motivated by the NGN source claim of hyperparameter-robust convergence: convergence need not imply per-step loss decrease. The theorem gives a full unique minimax calibration, a structural mode switch in worst-case states, and a separate sharp regularization cutoff for transient loss spikes, all dimension-independent and attainable. This is a natural optimization-method benchmark, beyond a single numerical example or retitling of a known fixed Polyak step.
